title: Media and Entertainment
summary: Series, films, media habits, and evaluating entertainment.
whyItMatters: Media conversations combine genres, habits, platforms, story elements, reactions, and reasons for a recommendation.

mentalModel.title: Describe before evaluating
mentalModel.content: Name the format, genre, topic, central figures, and basic situation before giving an opinion.

mentalModel.title: Connect reaction to a feature
mentalModel.content: Explain which story, character, image, or sound made the work exciting, funny, or disappointing.

ruleBlocks.title: Use genre and format vocabulary
ruleBlocks.content: Distinguish film, series, documentary, comedy, thriller, news, podcast, and game.

ruleBlocks.title: Describe media habits precisely
ruleBlocks.content: State device, platform, frequency, duration, company, and purpose.

ruleBlocks.title: Discuss content without retelling everything
ruleBlocks.content: Summarize the premise and select only details relevant to the evaluation.

examples.de: Ich sehe meistens abends eine Folge auf dem Tablet.
examples.en: I usually watch an episode on the tablet in the evening.

examples.de: Die Dokumentation handelt von nachhaltigem Reisen.
examples.en: The documentary is about sustainable travel.

examples.de: Die Serie ist spannend, weil die Figuren schwierige Entscheidungen treffen.
examples.en: The series is exciting because the characters make difficult decisions.

commonMistakes.wrong: Der Film geht über eine Familie.
commonMistakes.correct: Der Film handelt von einer Familie.
commonMistakes.reason: Handeln von is the standard expression for subject matter.

commonMistakes.wrong: Call something good without a feature or reason.

comparisons.summary: Media reactions use forms such as sich interessieren and sich erinnern.
The communication lesson structures comparison and recommendation.
